title: fix(app-shell): page block inspector list labels name their group
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8L4EbhLan2Y7fLAm2Hf41nK)_
Fixes #27256

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 页面块检查器里的三个列表编辑器（字段列表如「Columns」、字符串列表、数组）现在各自是一个以其标题命名的分组；只带占位提示的文本行输入框按「标题 + 序号」命名（如「Action names 1」）。
- 为什么改：这三个标题之前不指向任何控件，读屏用户只听到一串无名的行，分不清它们属于哪个属性。
- 风险与回滚：只加 ARIA 属性和一个很小的包装组件，不改数据、写入或布局；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`PageBlockInspector.tsx` 里新增的 `LabelledListGroup` 及三处调用；新测试 `PageBlockInspector.listGroupLabels-27256.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/PageBlockInspector.listGroupLabels-27256.test.tsx`，预期 4 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/PageBlockInspector.tsx`, the three list editors only:

- New `LabelledListGroup` component: the container takes `role="group"` and `aria-labelledby` pointing at the label's `id`, minted with `React.useId()` per instance. It is a component (not inline in `renderField`) because `renderField` is a function run in a loop over array items and cannot call a hook, and a caller-derived id would repeat across array rows. This is the same pattern `ColorPropField` already uses in this file.
- `FieldListField` (Columns, Fields, Card fields …), the `string-list` case and the `array` case of `renderField` all render through it.
- Row naming (the order asked to check the string-list rows): each string-list row input had no name but a repeated placeholder, so it now carries `aria-label` = the list label plus its 1-based position ("Action names 1"). Chosen over `aria-labelledby` plus an index element because no visible per-row index exists to point at. The field-list text fallback rows (shown when the object has no fields) had the same gap and get the same name. The field-list `Select` trigger rows are left alone: their name is the selected value's text, and an `aria-label` would hide it.

`app-shell` is `private: true`, so no changeset (`skip-changeset`).

## Why

Each of the three labels headed a list of rows and named nothing: `getByLabelText('Columns')` found the label and no control, and a screen reader heard the rows with no group name. A `for` pairing does not fit, since one label heads several controls.

## Tests

`PageBlockInspector.listGroupLabels-27256.test.tsx` (4 cases):

- `record:related_list`: `getByRole('group', { name: 'Columns' })` (field list) and `{ name: 'Sort' }` (array) each resolve; the row controls (combobox, `#1`, the remove buttons) sit inside their group; the IDREF resolves to the label element inside the group; the two ids differ.
- `record:quick_actions`: the `Action names` group holds textboxes named `Action names 1` and `Action names 2`.
- Field-list text fallback (object with no fields): the `Columns` group holds a textbox named `Columns 1`.
- `record:details` with two sections: two `Fields` groups inside the `Sections` group, each named by its own label with distinct ids.

## Acceptance notes

- Ablation (one-off, no file kept): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` swapped the group's `aria-labelledby={labelId}` for an inert attribute → 4 of 4 cases red (`Unable to find an accessible element with the role "group" and name …`); restore verified blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. A first attempt was refused by the tool before running anything (the replacement text already occurred in the file), so it measured nothing.
- The remove buttons in each list share one name ("Remove" / "Remove item") per row; left as is, out of this card's scope.
